reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes irradiation-induced defect clusters at grain boundaries will enhance sliding and ductility, whereas in reality such clusters typically pin boundaries and cause embrittlement, contradicting well-established radiation damage mechanisms.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements (DIC, TEM, toughness) and a decisive falsification criterion, though in situ mechanical testing under neutron flux is extremely challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a physically incorrect premise about irradiation effects on grain boundary sliding, and would misdirect research effort.
